claim_under_pricing: Does the M3224 high-speed observation/preview profile expose production-speed window-compression cells where a reveal-constrained oracle succeeds but the best disjoint-selection reflex-family arm fails?
claim_boundary: B2b high-speed pricing measurement only: scripted reflex baselines on the M3224 high-speed observation/preview profile, an explicitly scale-aware fixed* and per-cell tuned reflex floor, a nominal/no-spread inert RLS arm, and a reveal-constrained privileged oracle compared on high-speed obstacle windows. Zero training; no incumbent driver mutation, validation ranking, promotion, driver-performance, high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claim. Quick mode is protocol smoke only and is not a pricing verdict.

scenario_panel.placement_rule: Static centered obstacle with row jitter; distance is kept at least 2 m beyond reveal distance so the obstacle is initially hidden and then revealed under the M3224 high-speed profile.

high_speed_observation_profile.scale_adapter_policy: fixed_star, v4_rls, and v4_pertuned use known M3224 observation-scale canonicalization before applying the legacy scripted v2/v4 reflex formulas; fixed_v4_incumbent is reported as raw transfer on the scaled obs.

arms.fixed_v4_incumbent: canonical M3105 v4-v2 fallback reflex applied raw to the M3224 scaled obs; secondary transfer readout
arms.fixed_star: one global 27-grid scale-aware reflex retune selected on pooled selection rows only
arms.v4_rls: nominal/no-spread inert arm identical to fixed_star; B2b varies speed windows rather than vehicle population parameters
arms.v4_pertuned: per-cell 27-grid scale-aware reflex winner selected on disjoint selection rows only
arms.oracle: reveal-constrained privileged tail search after the obstacle is visible under fixed_star; structured candidates first, then CEM fallback

preregistered_readouts.primary_prize: oracle - v4_pertuned success rate on the oracle-solved denominator
preregistered_readouts.secondary_floor_gap: oracle - fixed_star success rate on the oracle-solved denominator
preregistered_readouts.scale_adapter_lift: fixed_star - fixed_v4_incumbent success rate on the oracle-solved denominator, reported as baseline engineering context only
preregistered_readouts.oracle_denominator: Rows where the reveal-constrained oracle solves are included in the primary denominator; oracle-infeasible rows are excluded and reported separately.
preregistered_readouts.secondary_degradation_axis: not run in this milestone; high-speed clean pricing must be adjudicated first. A degraded-sensing VoI table requires a separate preregistration if opened later.

quick_decision_rule: Accept M3241 quick protocol smoke iff the script exercises two cells, disjoint selection/validation seeds, finite high-speed rows on the M3224 profile, all validation rows reveal the obstacle under fixed_star, every validation row attempts oracle search, and each row either reaches CEM coverage or is solved by structured search. Quick mode is not a B2b pricing verdict.
decision_rule: B2b full pricing is positive iff >=2 full-panel cells have oracle_minus_pertuned >= 0.15 with paired bootstrap CI95 lower > 0 on the oracle-solved denominator. Either verdict feeds the roadmap and papers; no training is admitted by this artifact alone.
runtime_gates: raw composed_action must match the canonical v4 function bit-for-bit on random obs72 samples
the scale adapter must map a 36 m/s M3224-scaled speed channel back to 36 m/s under the legacy v4 decoder
selection and validation seeds must be disjoint
all probe rows must use the M3224 high-speed observation profile with preview time >= 2.45 s
quick smoke must pass before a full pricing run is interpreted
